title: Unpacking the Shema
videoTitle: The 6 Words Every Jew D!es Saying | Unpacked
purpose: Watch for how Jewish communities carry the Shema through prayer, ritual, and family life. This is historical and religious context; Scripture and the Apostolic standard establish the doctrine taught here.

review.scope: The publisher's own summary, topic classification, and public embedded player were checked. The video presents Jewish tradition and practice; it is not an Apostolic-Pentecostal doctrinal source.

lessonPlacements.purpose: Give learners a view of the Shema's lived Jewish setting, then distinguish historical context from the scriptural and Apostolic basis for doctrine.

lessonCheck.title: Keep the source in its right place
lessonCheck.prompt: What does this video add to the lesson?

choices.label: A view of the Shema’s place in Jewish prayer, ritual, and family life.
An Apostolic-Pentecostal doctrinal teaching on the Godhead.
A source that can replace reading the Bible passages in this lesson.

lessonCheck.correctFeedback: Right. The video helps you picture the Shema in Jewish life. Use Deuteronomy 6:4, Jesus’ repetition in Mark 12:29, and the Apostolic witness to establish doctrine.
lessonCheck.incorrectFeedback: Look at the source’s frame: it describes Jewish tradition and practice. That context can enrich the lesson, while Scripture and the Apostolic standard carry the doctrinal claim.
